1385-3968-4050-4078.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
1385-3968-4050-4078.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

5078-5741-7730-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

147-3085-3899.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3085-3899.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

539-767-4687.notablePrerequisites: Druids' Repository has at least four counters on it.
539-767-4687.description:
Activate Ashaya by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Druids' Repository.
Activate Druids' Repository as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Druids' Repository, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

3562-3817-6495-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sky Hussar, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sky Hussar from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.
3562-3817-6495-6542.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

339-677-4247-5295.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

222-527-4927-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4927-6495.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-4927-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

6495-7084-7705.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-7084-7705.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1011-2728-5662-6797.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-5662-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-5662-6797.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 4.

3944-5220-6900-7918.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying its mana cost.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-4131-7714.description:
Cast Basalt Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Basalt Monolith enters, Ultron triggers.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Ultron trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Basalt Monolith that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
During your next turn, activate the Basalt Monolith token by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the Basalt Monolith token.
Repeat from step 5.

1580-2292-4871-5075.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2438-3249-5173-5921.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1183-4050-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Pentavus.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.
1183-4050-6972.notes: Each loop, you can use mana from the previous loop and remove a +1/+1 counter from Pentavus to make creature tokens.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1242-2760-7503.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's first ability by tapping it.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Elegant Entourage triggers, giving Cinderhaze Wretch +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Cinderhaze Wretch ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

628-6798-7212.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Creakwood Safewright.
When Creakwood Safewright dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

4871-5223-7072.description:
Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.

3532-4908-5078-5240.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Oneirophage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

513-527-6965.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
513-527-6965.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

527-625-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
527-625-1978.description:
Cause Selvala to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3129-5220-5477-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-3129-5220-5477-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating two creature tokens and putting two +1/+1 counters on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

826-2178-6798-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it and Amoeboid Changeling trigger.
Resolve the Amoeboid Changeling trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Otherworldly Escort trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

874-985-2854-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
874-985-2854-4574.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-985-2854-4574.description:
Cast Delif's Cone either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Delif's Cone from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

671-2919-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-2919-4186.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

856-1808-2921-4321.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, creating a Clue and Food token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Eloise's second ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2034-2308-2606-4365-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pelakka Wurm, adding {C}{C}.
When Pelakka Wurm dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Pelakka Wurm trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Pelakka Wurm from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Pelakka Wurm enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain 7 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create two 4/4 Fungus Beast creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Fungus Beasts, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1978-2713-3371.manaNeeded: {4}, plus enough mana to pay for the nonland card's mana cost minus {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
1978-2713-3371.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one instant and/or sorcery card in hand.
1978-2713-3371.description:
Activate Codie by paying {4} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Codie.
Repeat as desired, skipping step 2 on the final iteration.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, cast any spell by paying its mana cost, reduced by the {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} added in step 1.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand as mana permits, and on subsequent turns.

3398-5039.notablePrerequisites:
The Reaver Cleaver attached to a creature with power seven or greater that can attack this turn.
An opponent is unable to block the creature with The Reaver Cleaver attached.
3398-5039.description:
Declare Hellkite Charger and the creature with The Reaver Cleaver attached as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and cause you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to a player with the creature that has The Reaver Cleaver attached.
The creature triggers, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Hellkite Charger and the creature with The Reaver Cleaver attached as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, holding priority, activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and cause you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3.

1344-2773.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Nested Ghoul indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Nested Ghoul.
1344-2773.description:
Give Nested Ghoul indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Nested Ghoul.
Nested Ghoul triggers, creating a 2/2 Phyrexian Zombie creature token.
The Phyrexian Zombie enters the battlefield, triggering Warstorm Surge, causing the Phyrexian Zombie to deal damage equal to its power to Nested Ghoul.
Repeat from step 3.

129-3995-4289.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-3995-4289.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

45-614-1987-2427.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
